# Arthur Scheidel - Unity Developer and Tech Co-Founder

> Unity game developer, mobile publishing co-founder, SDK builder, and indie creator. Tech co-founder of Sorolla. Based in Paris, France. Also known as LaCreArthur.

## Professional Summary

Arthur Scheidel is a Unity game developer and tech co-founder of Sorolla, a mobile game publishing effort focused on publisher SDKs, playable ads, release tooling, and publishing infrastructure. Self-taught in Unity and C#, he has shipped 20+ games. His background spans hyper-casual mobile work at Ubisoft/Ketchapp, Web3 gaming leadership, WebGL/full-stack engineering, independent games, and Unity teaching.

## Key Facts

- **Current Role**: Technical co-founder and game-tech lead at Sorolla
- **Location**: Paris, France; remote friendly
- **Experience**: 7+ years in game development and adjacent full-stack/product engineering
- **Education**: Master's in Computer Science (Software and Knowledge Engineering), with honors, University of Strasbourg, {{education.mscYear}}
- **Languages**: French, English

## Technical Skills

- **Game Development**: Unity, C#, Three.js, C++, game architecture
- **Mobile Publishing**: iOS ATT, ad network integration, analytics, ASO, release workflows
- **Playable Ads**: Three.js playable ad prototypes, MRAID-style constraints, mobile-first interaction
- **DevOps**: GitHub Actions, GameCI, Fastlane, Firebase Distribution
- **Web / Full Stack**: React, Angular, TypeScript, Python, Firebase
- **Historical Web3**: NFT integration, Web3 login, blockchain game prototypes

## Featured Work

### Sorolla Palette SDK
- Publisher SDK for Unity mobile games
- Focus: ATT, ads, analytics, low-friction publishing setup
- Public repository: {{links.sdk}}

### Happy Snake 3D
- Mobile game published by Sorolla, live on the App Store and Google Play
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/happy-snake-3d/id6755388400
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sorolla.hungrysnake3d

### Doge To Mars / Dogecoin To The Moon
- Dogecoin-community mobile game, built and shipped solo with no paid marketing
- 10K+ installs and a 4.5 rating on Google Play, grown organically
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bretzelstudio.dogecointothemoon
- GitHub/page: https://github.com/LaCreArthur/doge-to-mars-gh-page
- itch.io: https://lacrearthur.itch.io/dogecoin-to-the-moon

### Rody & Mastico Collection
- Unity remaster of the Atari ST Rody games with an integrated level editor (Rody Maker), built solo over ~3 years
- Voice synthesis rebuilt from scratch using the original 1987 phoneme technique (playable demo)
- Featured by French YouTubers Bob Lennon and Benzaie
- itch.io: https://lacrearthur.itch.io/rody-mastico-collection
- Website: https://lacrearthur.github.io/RodyAIbiza/
- Voice synth demo: https://lacrearthur.github.io/RodyAIbiza/Synth/index.html
- Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DEktCBMKopE

### Unity CI/CD Template
- GitHub Actions, GameCI, Fastlane, and Firebase Distribution template for Unity mobile releases
- GitHub: https://github.com/LaCreArthur/unity-fastlane-ci
